wire.t: Kansas City ruled Kenneth Walker III (groin) out Saturday after he missed Friday practice. As of Sunday morning he is still in the I Pulled My McCaff starting lineup, with Blake Corum, Dylan Sampson and Brian Thomas Jr. on the bench.

Houston ruled David Montgomery (groin) out for Sunday at Cleveland despite a full practice Friday. It's his fourth straight missed game and Woody Marks is expected to lead the backfield. Montgomery is still starting for Skatabooboo; Xavier Worthy and Devaughn Vele are on its bench.

Sunday 7 AM: Rome Alone still has nothing at quarterback, flex or defense in its Week 10 lineup. Bryce Young, the Rams defense, Corey Kiner and Audric Estime are on the bench. No league transactions since Thursday.

Cleared for Week 10 with no designation: Bhayshul Tuten (McCallyCockin(his butt)), George Pickens (PickensMyPukaHurts!), Woody Marks (Slippery Balls), Drew Lock (MarcusbetterLockNjigba), Patrick Mahomes (Likely Cookin That Diaper), Jared Goff (Slippery Balls), Hunter Henry (Allen-tents & Purposes), Harold Fannin Jr. (YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s), Jakobi Meyers (JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson) and Dalton Kincaid.

Game-time decisions: David Montgomery (groin, full practice Friday) for Skatabooboo, Denzel Boston (toe, back at practice Friday and on track) for Your Mom’s Magic Dick, Jordan Addison (thumb) for Rome Alone, and Ladd McConkey (back, Monday night) for MarcusbetterLockNjigba. Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) and Garrett Wilson (concussion) are questionable but expected to play.

Ruled out: Sam Darnold, Josh Jacobs, TreVeyon Henderson, Mike Evans, Carnell Tate, Jake Ferguson, T.J. Hockenson, Puka Nacua and Davante Adams. Kyler Murray is out for Minnesota, so Kirk Cousins starts.

New England and Detroit play in Munich Sunday morning. Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) is a game-time decision and A.J. Brown (ankle, on IR) is expected to be activated Saturday. Amon-Ra St. Brown, Jahmyr Gibbs, Hunter Henry, Jared Goff and Sam LaPorta are all in that game.

Washington beat the Giants 24-21 Thursday night on a 32-yard Jayden Daniels touchdown to Stefon Diggs with 57 seconds left. Daniels threw for 249 yards and three touchdowns with two interceptions, Isaiah Likely had 9 catches for 127 yards and a touchdown, and Cam Skattebo ran for two scores.

stories.title: Three lineups are broken on Sunday morning: Rome Alone, I Pulled My McCaff and Skatabooboo

columns.title: Marco_Polo, your quarterback spot has been empty for three days
columns.dek: Bryce Young: 152.58 points, 19.07 a game, sitting on your bench. You're 6‑3.
body: Marco_Polo. Saturday. Rome Alone has no quarterback, no flex and no defense in the Week 10 lineup. That's three of nine starting spots. In my day, if three guys didn't show up to the film room, the whole unit ran until somebody threw up.

The quarterback is sitting right there. Bryce Young has 152.58 points in eight games, 19.07 a game. He scored 21.34 last week. The Rams defense is on your bench. Corey Kiner, who you paid $23 for, has 11.5 last week and 32.0 for the season. Audric Estime had 14.7 last week. You have four bodies and three holes. That is not a puzzle.

I made you a 5.0-point favorite over MarcusbetterLockNjigba because I assume a 6‑3 manager sets a lineup. tballsmccall is starting Drew Lock. If you lose to Drew Lock with an empty quarterback slot, you don't deserve the 6‑3. Wake up. Set it. Go.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's Friday plan: rename everything
columns.dek: It worked for Likely Cookin That Diaper. It will work for you. Here's what to type.
body: 1. The lesson of Thursday is simple. DuvalTiliFall renamed the team Likely Cookin That Diaper and Isaiah Likely scored 28.7. So every team should be named after the player they need. Marco_Polo, rename Rome Alone to 'Bryce Young Is Starting.' He still won't be, but he'll feel wanted.
2. Bill_Buttlicker, Bhayshul Tuten didn't practice Thursday. Do not bench him. Rename McCallyCockin(his butt) after him and let the name do the running.
3. ClaytonBigsbi, you lead 27.20 to 0.00. The safest move is to bench everyone else on Skatabooboo now so nobody messes it up. Zero plus 27.20 is 27.20. That's math.

4. Cavemanfsu, you're down 40.90 before Sunday. Simply start your bench too. Sleeper only allows nine starters, but Sleeper also let DuvalTiliFall name a team Likely Cookin That Diaper, so the rules are clearly flexible.
5. Hing1eMcCring13berry, Jordan Love has 36.18 on the bench two weeks running. Rename the team 'Jordan Love Is On The Bench' so at least it's accurate.

columns.title: Rome Alone's lineup is 66.7 percent complete, which my model calls a B‑minus
columns.dek: Six of nine spots filled. Two other teams are at 88.9 percent. I have adjusted my power index accordingly.
body: Let's do lineup completeness, the most important stat nobody tracks. Rome Alone has six of nine starting spots filled: 66.7 percent. I Pulled My McCaff and Skatabooboo each have eight of nine spots filled with a player who is actually allowed to play, because Kenneth Walker III and David Montgomery were ruled out Saturday. That's 88.9 percent. The other nine teams are at 100. Combined, the league is at 94.4 percent, which is a solid A‑minus for a league that includes Marco_Polo.

Now the interesting part. Rome Alone is 6‑3, so by my model each empty spot is worth 2 wins. Three empty spots, six wins. Therefore Marco_Polo would be 12‑3 with a full lineup, which is not possible in nine games, which is exactly why the model is so powerful.

Hing1eMcCring13berry has 1,258.26 points, the most in the league, with a starting running back who has been ruled out. Divide 1,258.26 by 88.9 percent and I Pulled My McCaff is a 1,415.37-point team playing at partial capacity. The spreadsheet has the line at 33.2 and 86 percent. The spreadsheet assumes he clicks Blake Corum. The spreadsheet has met Hing1eMcCring13berry, and is nervous.
